question.text: Mr. Rajesh Menon is setting up 'Aravali Opportunities AIF' as a trust structure. The settlor conveys the initial corpus to the trustee. Which document is the foundational instrument that brings this trust into existence and also serves as the instrument of trusteeship?

answer.text: The Private Placement Memorandum filed with SEBI
The Trust Indenture (Trust Deed) executed between settlor and trustee
The Investment Management Agreement between trustee and manager
The Contribution Agreement between trustee and first investor

explanation.text: The Logic: Per p.342, a trust AIF is constituted through a Trust Indenture executed between the settlor and the trustee, which is required to be registered. Per p.343, the trust document is the instrument of trusteeship and relates to the determinate corpus and associated tax treatment. The Trap: The PPM is an offer/disclosure document, the Investment Management Agreement governs the manager's appointment, and the Contribution Agreement governs an investor's subscription — none of these is the constitutional/trusteeship instrument identified in the source. Note: The Trust Indenture is both constitutional (brings the trust into existence) and the instrument of trusteeship per pp.342-343.
